# Roadmap closure template

Create one closure for the completed roadmap scope, not one archive per task.
Link it from the history index and update references before removing active work.
Existing evidence remains at its canonical location.

```markdown
# <Outcome> — <date>

**Lifecycle:** historical
**Roadmap source:** ROADMAP.md, <phase ID and original heading>
**Planning baseline:** <full Git commit containing the last detailed planning>
**Work IDs:** <related TODO and task IDs>
**Outcome:** <delivered result or explicit cancellation>
**Evidence:** <links to existing canonical records>
**Limitations:** <unverified scope and accepted exclusions, or none>

## Preserved roadmap

<Original completed roadmap block: rationale, intended outcome and criteria.>

## Acceptance disposition

| Criterion | Outcome | Evidence or explicit disposition |
|---|---|---|
| <Original criterion> | <Result> | <Record link and relevant limit> |

## Important nested decisions

<Only details that would otherwise be lost. Prefer references; omit this
section when the roadmap and evidence already explain the outcome.>
```

Keep lasting constraints and freezes in their current governing documents.
For legacy direct-owner work without a roadmap block, state that absence and
reference its original scope; do not invent a historical roadmap.
